name: orchestrator
description: Macro orchestration capability — multi-deliverable plan + Plan-verify ensemble for AI-assisted development across Claude Code & Codex CLI. L2 capability plugin per ADR-0010 4-layer composition (ADR-0018 §sub-decision-1, plan-only MVP).

interface.shortDescription: Macro orchestration — multi-deliverable plan + Plan-verify ensemble
interface.longDescription: L2 capability plugin per ADR-0010 4-layer composition + ADR-0018 §sub-decision-1. First multi-verb L2 occupant (single-verb capability precedent ADR-0010 §3 does not apply). Provides /orchestrator:plan — a macro plan command that produces a list of deliverables (subtasks[]) and verifies the plan via a Codex peer ensemble. Single Responsibility: orchestration only; cognitive activity (single-deliverable thought) remains engineer's responsibility. Workflow files at <repo>/.claude/agentic-orchestrator/workflows/ with schema '1.0' (distinct from engineer's schema 1.1). plan-only MVP — /orchestrator:next and /orchestrator:done ship in follow-up PRs alongside the cross-plugin invocation contract (ADR-0018 §sub-1 follow-up ADR).
defaultPrompt: $orchestrator:plan Implement schema 1.1 → 1.2 reader/writer migration as a multi-deliverable feature
